attchmntText: Visagar Polytex Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Visagar Polytex Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 13th November 2026. The Board approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The statutory auditor, CA Riddhi Trivedi, issued a Limited Review Report with an unmodified opinion. The company reported a basic earnings per share of negative 0.00 for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 and negative 0.03 for the half year ended 30th September 2026. Total assets stood at 601.64 lakhs as of 30th September 2026. Cash and cash equivalents were 0.01 lakhs. Trade receivables increased to 105.23 lakhs from 88.55 lakhs. The trading window for dealing in company securities will open after 48 hours of the results being made public on 13th November 2026.
